verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that BILL publishes its own documentation MCP server for external AI tools such as Cursor and Claude Desktop. That is the MCP server role, not the client capability of plugging third-party MCP servers into BILL Spend & Expense so its AI features can use their tools. The pack has no evidence that the product can act as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
